description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various emotions, comparing their relative proportions. The chart is divided into six slices, each representing a distinct emotion. The slices are labeled as Frustration (light blue, 25.1%), Neutral (blue, 23.1%), Anger (yellow, 14.9%), Sadness (orange, 14.7%), Excitement (red, 14.1%), and Happiness (dark red, 8.1%). The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice, and the slices are arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest slice (Frustration) positioned at the top left and the smallest slice (Happiness) at the top right. The segments appear to be ordered by size in a generally descending order, starting from Frustration and Neutral, followed by the other emotions.
